name: figma-bridge
description: Bridges Figma designs to SwiftUI / UIKit code for engineers collaborating with a designer (or working from a Figma mockup). Sets up the Figma MCP server for Claude Code or Codex, establishes Code Connect mappings so the engineer's real code surfaces inside Figma's Dev Mode, generates first-draft SwiftUI from a selected Figma frame, maps the codebase ↔ design with a comment-as-sitemap convention, and reviews Figma files for developer-friendliness (auto-layout, components, variants, naming, frame size). Hands off to apple-platform-ui for the HIG polish pass. The complement to apple-platform-ui's pure-indie / no-Figma path.
